title: What's New in Cloth NeXt 2.4.0
subtitle: The next Beta: reliable previews and smoother onboarding.

highlights.title: Reliable Live Preview
highlights.description: Rebake and Recovery show the current run while keeping your previous cache available for rollback.

highlights.title: Ready When You Are
highlights.description: Welcome and What's New open through the Companion, with manual access whenever you need it in Preferences.

highlights.title: Safer Cache Handling
highlights.description: Previous results remain recoverable after cancellation or failure, and obsolete cache cleanup stays bounded.

improvements.text: Welcome, What's New, and changelog access remain available in Preferences.
Viewport state resets safely when opening another Blender file.

fixes.text: Cache cleanup bounds directory traversal before deleting obsolete files.
Onboarding clears stale reload timers and records seen state only after the Companion is ready.
